delta_review.summary: One documentation commit claims closure of the four cycle-nine blockers by expanding flow-style credential scanning, canonical state validation, reopened-Draft lineage, and CODEX_HOME discovery.

finding_revalidation.evidence: Top-level flow and plural-container regressions now fail, but a source-like assignment with an embedded flow object containing plural apiKeys still returns SECRETS PASS and aggregate PASS.

Role routes and positive fixture generation improved, but the production checker still accepts nested canonical feature artifacts that workflowctl rejects, including an empty plan or requirements object.

The synchronized replacement attack now fails and the checker binds the first reopen's submitted commit, actor, time, reason, decision, transition message, new requirements and prior acceptance evidence.
Absolute CODEX_HOME now works, but workflowctl expands a literal leading tilde while the checker passes the raw value to path.resolve, so a supported workflowctl-valid root is unreadable.
Complete pagination, boundary, duplicate, count and digest regressions remain green in the refreshed 162-case harness.
The refreshed harness retains and passes every cycle-two authority, mutation and contract regression.
The refreshed harness retains and passes every original governance and error-output regression.

findings.title: Embedded flow credentials still bypass authorization-grade scanning
findings.observation: The scalar-assignment matcher does not classify plural apiKeys and the recursive flow parser runs only after an anchored YAML-like key match. A source-like assignment containing a nested flow object with a plural apiKeys container therefore receives exit 0, SECRETS PASS and aggregate PASS.
findings.trigger: A tracked Markdown or source example embeds a flow-style object containing a plural credential container after ordinary source text.
findings.impact: A real API credential can be committed while the mandatory authorization-grade checker reports PASS.

evidence.description: The tracked contract requires recursive flow-style scanning and singular/plural credential-container normalization.
The exact-head embedded-flow fixture exits 0 with SECRETS PASS and aggregate PASS; output SHA-256 is 0569a2eec75d73f8185b60f85e488e18c54fcf0dd9fb048917a78a9fc1cb0b75.

findings.remediation: Scan flow-style objects and plural sensitive containers regardless of syntactic offset in a tracked line, or use fail-closed tokenization that cannot be bypassed by a source-code prefix; add this exact composition with value-redacted diagnostics to the harness.
findings.verification: At a new exact head, retain deterministic positive evidence while the exact embedded composition and all prior structured-secret fixtures fail with no credential value in diagnostics.

findings.title: Checker validation remains weaker than canonical workflowctl state
findings.observation: The local canonicalLifecycleShape validator checks feature requirements as an arbitrary object and requires only plan presence rather than workflowctl's exact artifact fields and cross-field invariants. Starting from a workflowctl-generated positive, replacing a referenced feature plan with an empty object makes workflowctl reject the state while the checker still reports 13/13 PASS.
findings.trigger: Canonical state is corrupted inside a nested feature requirements or plan artifact while the surrounding dispatch and projection evidence remains intact.
findings.impact: Malformed durable lifecycle state can authorize a full PASS, so the public checker is not actually bound to the canonical controller invariants it claims to enforce.

evidence.description: The tracked contract requires complete workflowctl state/config invariants, exact keys and nested artifact snapshots.

workflowctl rejects an empty feature plan as missing compositeSha256, design, implementationPlan, planCommitSha and requirements; the unmodified checker returns 13/13 PASS. Output SHA-256 is 97c3d18eb3db6098df733291c2b485ed2b4c2c33a882bb527e16b0b053be4e3c.
The independent pass reproduced the same semantic gap with an empty requirements artifact; output SHA-256 is 59613362b5887ae367049b7423c801d35c21f91e9bde8c36107beb33bc441069.

findings.remediation: Reuse workflowctl canonical validation or implement an equivalence-tested validator for every nested artifact, stage gate, GoalRun, queue, dispatch, merge/release and cross-field invariant; add differential mutations that require every workflowctl-invalid state to fail.
findings.verification: At a new exact head, mutate every canonical nested structure and require checker acceptance to be a subset of workflowctl acceptance while all supported workflowctl-generated positives remain deterministic.

findings.title: Literal-tilde CODEX_HOME differs from workflowctl semantics
findings.observation: workflowctl expands CODEX_HOME before resolving it, while the checker passes the environment value directly to path.resolve. With HOME isolated and CODEX_HOME set to the literal string ~/codex-home, workflowctl validates the Ready state but the checker cannot read canonical durable state.
findings.trigger: A supported installation configures CODEX_HOME with a leading tilde instead of an absolute path.
findings.impact: A workflowctl-valid non-Draft lifecycle installation is rejected, blocking legitimate plan transitions.

evidence.description: The updated contract explicitly requires CODEX_HOME expansion and normalization matching workflowctl.

workflowctl returns the Ready feature at DEVELOPMENT_QUEUED while the checker returns FAIL because canonical state cannot be read; output SHA-256 is ca4bd6a5d6cb0e86281ef897d57a202792cd35fd38cf002ae7269e30cfc7830e.
The independent pass reproduced the mismatch; output SHA-256 is 98cbdbfd5ff595f6f4c0cdeee30d0a4331b6448de804b936706170fc1bebe8b1.

findings.remediation: Resolve CODEX_HOME with the same expanduser and normalization semantics as workflowctl and add an unmodified production-checker fixture using literal-tilde CODEX_HOME.
findings.verification: At a new exact head, literal-tilde and equivalent absolute CODEX_HOME roots must resolve the same state and produce the same authority digest.
